challenge-blueticket: A Vue weather dashboard with local city search, privacy-safe location matching, six-hour conditions, and browser-cached forecast history.
challenge-castlabs: A React episode manager with title and series search, detailed records, local create/delete flows, and simulated real-time subscription feedback.
challenge-climateseed: A Vue carbon dashboard that compares organisation emissions and team sizes, switches chart formats, and accepts new emissions records.
challenge-conaz: A collection of interactive JavaScript exercises for character counting, run-length encoding, and synchronising member records.
challenge-devlandia: A browser adaptation of two Ruby pathfinding programs that calculate the next move and complete route across a grid.
challenge-fyld-hansecom: A Nuxt movie-search interface that filters a bundled catalog and presents release years, ratings, and plot summaries in wide text cards.
challenge-ingenious-build-frontend: A Vue bus timetable for selecting lines and stops, viewing sorted departure times, and searching the complete stop directory.
challenge-instruct: A responsive lead-management table with contact-name search and combinable filters derived from company categories.
challenge-jexperts: A full-stack employee directory for creating, editing, deleting, and approximately searching users with contact, role, address, and reporting details.
challenge-lagoasoft: A React social feed that renders five local posts and maintains an independent browser-only like vote for each one.
challenge-meetime: A Vue sales-prospecting client for listing, editing, deleting, and adding leads to selected outbound cadences.
challenge-onsign-tv: A Vue weather application that resolves a location and presents the next six hours of temperature and condition forecasts with local caching.
challenge-pipz: A faithful React recreation of the original Star Wars intro and perspective crawl, listing seven films with Roman episode numbers and release dates.
challenge-propertiag: A tested React calculator that validates integers from 1 to 1,000 and converts them into Roman numerals.
challenge-salsify: A React product-data table for browsing structured catalog records in a compact, sortable portfolio interface.
challenge-stormtech: A full-stack book catalog that loads records from MongoDB and demonstrates several title, author, and edition sorting scenarios.
challenge-swordhealth: A Vue news platform with category filtering, progressive article loading, detail pages, a user profile, and local article authoring.
challenge-vue: A Vue Formula 1 explorer for selecting leading drivers and reviewing their team, nationality, points, and season statistics.
challenge-vuejs: A Vue television episode guide with local show data, pagination, episode details, and a deterministic browsing experience.
challenge-zygo: An interactive presentation of JavaScript book-sorting algorithms across title, author, and publication-edition criteria.
